index_policy: Each molecule has independent atom_id values; its SMILES, atom/bond tables and additional stereochemical constraints jointly define its identity. Named chemical numbering in the facts does not automatically equal atom_id. Report any conflict and discontinue use of the conflicting entry; do not silently substitute a different molecule. For R/S comparisons, use the accurate algorithm declared in cip_assignment; a legacy-descriptor discrepancy alone is not a molecular-identity conflict. Never alter supplied stereochemistry to match a legacy label.

cip_assignment.policy: CIP descriptors are derived from the supplied stereochemical structures using the accurate CIPLabeler. Preserve atom_id and the structures. Diagnose legacy-algorithm or atom-numbering differences before treating descriptors as identity conflicts. Genuine connectivity or stereochemical conflicts still require resolution before calculation.
